biography.value:
Published alignment: NE/N.

Description

Scales the color of black armor this ferocious juvenile dragon while crowned with large curved pointy horns.

Defense

AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 20 (+4 dex, +11 natural, -1 size)

hp 114 [180] (12d12+36)

mp 75

Fort +11, Ref +14, Will +9

DR 5/magic; Immune Shadow, Paralysis, Sleep; SR 21

Weakness Holy

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)

Melee Bite +16 (2d6+7), 2 Claws +16 (1d8+5), 2 Wings +14 (1d6+2), Tail Slap +14 (1d8+7)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Black Waves, Breath Weapon (80-ft. line, 6d10 shadow damage, Reflex DC 19 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

Special Abilities Fearful Bay, Ragnarok

Spells Known (FC CL 12th, Concentration +19)

At will - bleed, dark orb, detect magic, message, read magic

1st (DC 19) - bone armor, dark, fear

2nd (DC 20) - dark II, death armor, death knell

3rd (DC 21) - blacklight, dark III, darkra, dispel, haste, infect (DC 20)

4th (DC 22) - bestow curse (DC 21), dark IV, dread spikes, greater fear, slay living (DC 21)

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 24

Base Atk +12; CMB +18; CMD 29 (33 vs. trip)

Feats Combat Casting, Elemental Focus (Dark), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack

Skills Fly +12, Intimidate +21, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Perception +15, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +22, Survival +15; Racial Modifiers +8 Stealth

Languages Common, Draconic

description.value: As a standard action, a black dragon spreads dark waves from herself. All creatures within a 30 ft.-radius must make a Reflex save (DC 23) for half damage or take 3d6+12 points of shadow damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

effect: As a standard action, a black dragon spreads dark waves from herself. All creatures within a 30 ft.-radius must make a Reflex save (DC 23) for half damage or take 3d6+12 points of shadow damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, a black dragon howls, all creatures within a 30-foot spread except evil outsiders must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or become panicked for 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected by the same black dragon's fearful bay for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

save.description: Negates panic 1d4 rounds and confers 24-hour immunity

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the black dragon devours the sun, plunging the area into supernatural darkness for 1d4+1 rounds. This affects an area of 120 feet and cannot be dispelled except by a daylight spell. All creatures gain total concealment and vision equivalent to a hume in darkness. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
